Three lessons from my emails and records.
One: the process stops until the balance is paid—my
provider chased me six times.
Two: use online methods and keep everything in writing,
because online records act as databases.
Three: connect your drive and emails to AI over
MCP. When things go wrong, learn from them and iterate.
